name: Download self-test file
purpose: A 1 KB text file (the MIT licence text of Tauri) used to check that downloads work on this computer. It is not an AI model. Real models are added with feature 002.

name: Python runtime (windows x64)
purpose: The Python 3.11 program that runs the speech and translation models. It is a one-time download and is not part of the installer.

name: Python runtime (macos x64)
purpose: The Python 3.11 program that runs the speech and translation models. It is a one-time download and is not part of the installer.

name: Python runtime (macos arm64)
purpose: The Python 3.11 program that runs the speech and translation models. It is a one-time download and is not part of the installer.

name: FFmpeg (x64 Windows)
purpose: Reads video and audio files, cuts them, and builds the finished dubbed file. LGPL build, no GPL parts.

name: FFmpeg (arm64 Windows)
purpose: Reads video and audio files, cuts them, and builds the finished dubbed file. LGPL build, no GPL parts.

name: Speech recognition (small)
purpose: Turns speech into text, with times for each line. Larger models are more accurate and slower.

name: Speech recognition (medium)
purpose: Turns speech into text, with times for each line. Larger models are more accurate and slower.

name: Speech recognition (large-v3)
purpose: Turns speech into text, with times for each line. Larger models are more accurate and slower.

name: Translation (M2M100 418M)
purpose: Translates text between about 100 languages. Small and quick.

name: Translation (M2M100 1.2B)
purpose: Translates between about 100 languages with better quality. Needs more memory.

name: Voice and music separation (htdemucs)
purpose: Splits a soundtrack into voices and music, so the music can stay under the dub.

name: Speaker separation
purpose: Tells which person is speaking on each line, so each speaker can get a different voice.

name: Pronunciation data (eSpeak NG)
purpose: Pronunciation rules the Piper voices need to read text aloud.

name: Voice: English (US), LJ Speech voice
purpose: Reads the translated text aloud.

name: Voice: English (UK), Alba voice
purpose: Reads the translated text aloud.

name: Voice: French, Siwis voice
purpose: Reads the translated text aloud.

name: Voice: German, Thorsten voice
purpose: Reads the translated text aloud.

name: Voice: Spanish (Spain), DaveFX voice
purpose: Reads the translated text aloud.

purpose: Reads video and audio files, cuts them, and builds the finished dubbed file. LGPL build, no GPL parts.

purpose: Reads video and audio files, cuts them, and builds the finished dubbed file. LGPL build, no GPL parts.
